plan: (Set EITHER planPath OR plan, not both — if both are present, planPath wins. ALTERNATIVE to planPath: paste the approved plan markdown here as a string. The orchestrating agent authors the plan in PLAN MODE — see CLAUDE.md for the section shape: ## Feature / ## Acceptance Criteria / ## Integration Points / ## Implementation Steps / ## Files / ## Test Strategy / ## Gate.)
conventions: Coding conventions the reviewer judges against: language/version constraints, what stays additive, style, and what NOT to touch (legacy business logic).

gates.build: SHELL COMMAND that compiles/lints — a non-zero exit code means FAIL (this gate must ALWAYS pass)
gates.test: SHELL COMMAND that runs the test suite
gates.testSetup: Notes for authoring + running tests: how to scope a single test, runner quirks, run-as-user / container exec prefix, fixtures/DB isolation, or how to start a server for curl/MCP verification.

baselineNote: Describe any EXPECTED pre-existing working-tree changes so they are folded into the staged baseline rather than treated as feature work. Omit if the tree is clean.
